title: $t(common:entities.investments)
subtitle: Your portfolio, operations and market data in one place.

activities.title: Activity history
activities.loadError: Could not load the activity history.
activities.linkedTransactionHelp: This activity belongs to a transaction in the finance module. It can only be changed from there.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Shared market instruments and the assets you create yourself.
assets.userDescription: Assets you create are valued with the prices you register by hand.
assets.userEmpty: You have not created any assets yet.
assets.sharedDescription: Instruments with automatic market prices and exchange rates.

form.createDescription: Create a custom asset. Its currency is your local currency.
form.editDescription: Only the name and sector can be changed.
form.name: Name
form.sectorHelp: Pick a suggested code or type your own sector.
form.originHelp: Indicates whether you already owned it before starting to track investments.
form.initialPriceHelp: Starting valuation used until you register a new price.
form.editImmutableHint: Type, origin and currency cannot be changed once the asset exists.
form.invalid: Check the name, sector and initial price.

price.title: Register price
price.help: The price is applied from now on and affects the portfolio valuation.

prices.title: Prices of {{name}}
prices.description: Market prices stored for this instrument.
prices.invalidRange: The start date must be before the end date.

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.description: Historical rates used to convert between currencies.
fx.invalidRange: The start date must be before the end date.
fx.loadError: Could not load the exchange rates.

closedLots.title: Closed lots
closedLots.description: Lots sold during the selected period.
closedLots.empty: No lots were closed in this period.
closedLots.loadError: Could not load the closed lots.

common.catalogUnavailable: The asset catalog could not be loaded; names are shown with their identifier.

edit.title: Edit activity
edit.description: Changes are audited and the portfolio is rebuilt.
edit.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why you are editing this activity…
edit.requiredFields: Complete the required fields and the reason.
edit.currencyImmutable: The currency of this activity cannot be changed.
edit.auditHelp: Every edit keeps a history of the previous and new values.

health.title: Data check
health.description: Automatic checks on prices, exchange rates and ledger consistency.
health.unavailable: Could not check your data right now.
health.loadError: Could not load the health report.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Starting snapshots for positions you already had before using the module.
holdings.emptyFiltered: There are no holdings for this asset.

table.title: Registered holdings
table.description: The active snapshot is used as the starting point of the position.

create.title: New holding
create.description: Record a position that already existed at a given moment.
create.snapshotAtHelp: The position reflects the quantity you owned at that instant.
create.currencyHint: The cost is expressed in the asset currency: {{currency}}.
create.singleActiveHint: Only one active holding can exist per asset.
create.noActivityHint: The asset cannot have recorded activities on or before the snapshot date.
create.futureSnapshot: The snapshot date cannot be in the future.
create.invalid: Select an asset and fill in a positive quantity and a valid cost.

history.title: History of {{asset}}
history.description: Replace the snapshot with the real operations. The result must match the quantity and cost of the holding exactly.
history.afterSnapshot: It must be on or before the snapshot date.
history.localCostHint: The backend converts with the historical exchange rate.
history.inKindPriceHint: A market price must exist for the dividend date.
history.oversold: You are selling more quantity than you hold at that point.
history.invalidSplit: A split requires a positive ratio and an open position.
history.quantityMismatch: The quantity does not match the holding yet.
history.costMismatch: The cost does not match the holding yet.
history.costUnknownHint: Some purchase is in local currency, so only the backend can verify the exact cost.
history.replaceWarning: The current holding will be marked as replaced and the portfolio will be rebuilt.

ledger.title: Ledger snapshot
ledger.description: Complete backup of investment data, intended for advanced use.
ledger.snapshotHint: Download a JSON file with holdings, activities, prices and audits.

restore.title: Restore ledger
restore.actionHint: Validates and merges the content with your current data.
restore.fileHelp: JSON file generated from this same section.
restore.invalidFile: The file is not a valid investment snapshot.
restore.parseError: Could not read the file as JSON.
restore.warning: Restoring modifies ledger data. Review the file before continuing; this action cannot be undone.
restore.confirm: I understand that this action modifies my investment data.

marketData.title: Market data
marketData.description: Update shared-asset prices and exchange rates.
marketData.statusHint: Prices are refreshed automatically. You can force an update from the last stored entry up to today.
marketData.autoRange: Data will be downloaded from each series' last stored entry up to today.
marketData.noPairs: No pairs selected. Only market prices will be refreshed.
marketData.slowWarning: Querying external providers can take several minutes. Keep this page open until it finishes.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Portfolio evolution for the selected period, based on tracking data.
performance.reconciliationWarning: There is a difference between the change and its components. Some price or exchange rate may be missing.
performance.estimatedNote: The calculation includes estimated values where exact history is not available.
performance.unavailable: Not enough data to calculate performance.

portfolio.disclaimer: The valuation uses the latest available price and exchange rate.
portfolio.cashDescription: Managed cash balances in the portfolio.
portfolio.cashEmpty: There is no cash in the portfolio.

record.title: Record activity
record.description: Add a buy, sell, dividend or cash movement to the portfolio.
record.unitPriceHelp: Enter the price in the asset currency ({{assetCurrency}}). The amount will be settled in your local currency ({{localCurrency}}) using the historical exchange rate.
record.exchangeHelp: The backend applies the exchange rate in force at that moment.
record.inKindHelp: The backend takes the reference price for the dividend date.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.description: Starting point of the portfolio in the module.
tracking.notConfiguredDescription: Set the date from which you want to start tracking your portfolio. You can keep using assets and market data without tracking.
tracking.notConfiguredHint: Set a start date to use the portfolio, activity history and performance.
tracking.setupDescription: Choose the date from which you want to record activities.
tracking.setupNotice: Managed cash starts on this date. Earlier operations can rebuild positions, but are not part of the cash.
tracking.immutableWarning: This date cannot be changed later. Choose it carefully.
tracking.immutableHint: The tracking start date cannot be changed once configured.
tracking.invalidDate: Choose a valid date that is not in the future.
tracking.loadError: Could not load the tracking settings.
